{{Quote|I was once a great Sith. But I looked into the abyss. I followed the Children, and the First Son found out. The scalpel and bright lights took my name. Now I serve, as Stark.|Stark explaining to the Barsen'thor|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Stark''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He tried to discover the truth behind the [[Children of the Emperor]], but was captured and brainwashed by the [[Syo Bakarn|First Son]] and became a loyal servant of him. Later, he kidnapped the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tobas Grell]] in deep space, [[Death/Legends|killing]] three of his guards in the process. He interrogated the Senator about the Rift Alliance's plans and eventually executed him for resisting his questions. Later, [[The Barsen'thor]] and Tobas' daughter, [[Nadia Grell]] arrived on Stark's ship to confront him and save Tobas. Upon learning of her father's death, an enraged Nadia engaged Stark and defeated him with the Barsen'thor. Stark died in the confrontation.
